excerpt: The security scanner for startups and small businesses. First scan free. Enter your site and get a complete report: what RiskRift found, the evidence, and how to fix it. Something concrete for your developer, your agency or your security team to work from. - No credit card - No subscription - Nothing to install - Full report included One free scan per account and per domain. You confirm the site is yours before anything runs. Built for growing teams. Startups and small businesses run real logins, checkouts and customer accounts, often before they have someone dedicated to security. RiskRift gives them a concrete first look. It works alongside security specialists and doesn’t replace them. Your site, seen by an attacker RiskRift tests your live site from the internet, the way an attacker would, without access to your code. It shows what is really reachable from outside: configuration left wrong at deployment, such as missing security headers, and flaws in the running application. It doesn’t replace a code audit. Keep reviewing and auditing the code you write: RiskRift checks what actually reaches the internet. - Before you launch - Test the new site or feature before customers depend on it. - Before a client or investor asks - Know where you stand when the security questions arrive. The report is evidence to work from, not a certification. - As part of your releases - Start a scan from your CI/CD pipeline through the API, and stop the release at the severity you choose. - When your developer is your whole tech team - The summary is for you. The evidence, reproduction steps and fixes are for them, or for your agency. Judge the report before you sign up. This is a complete RiskRift report, from cover to last page. Open it now. We don’t ask for your email. - Findings - 27 - Rated High - 8 - Pages - 138 Open the full report (PDF) Six of those findings, in plain English All 27 findings in this report come with impact, evidence, steps to reproduce and a fix.
